scripts.deploy: npm run build:wasm && next build && firebase deploy
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --manifest-path ../TanScript/Cargo.toml -p tanscript-playground --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../TanScript/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/tanscript_playground.wasm', 'public/tanscript.wasm')"
